$comment: Pulse config. `brief` is the user's standing identity / voice rules / hard rules / current writing goal — delivered to the agent as a hidden chat-init message at session start (see pulse-app.js sendInitPrompt). `workspace_path` is the workspace ROOT (read-only permission grant + the dir gather-local scans for commits); it may be a parent holding several repos. `product_repos` lists the repos that describe the product being launched — absolute, `~/…`, or relative to `workspace_path`, up to 6; the page reads each one's README + latest CHANGELOG entry into the PRODUCT DIGEST that prefixes every drafting goal, so drafts cite real features instead of guessing. Empty `product_repos` = just `workspace_path`. `default_goal` is used when a run is triggered without an explicit goal. `sites` toggles source tools + per-site config. `targets` toggles output lanes + per-lane config. Goals dispatch capabilities; capabilities call enabled sites and draft for enabled targets. Reddit is dual-role. `mention` says how drafts may name your product: `product` + `domain` (the site, said as plain text — never a URL), `default` register on threads where the product is the direct answer ("disclosed" | "implicit"), `ratio` = max share of your recent comments that may carry it (Reddit's 10% rule → 0.1, counted by the page from your own comments), `sites` = per-lane overrides. Empty `product` = implicit everywhere.
default_goal: Daily X-post if I shipped or learned something yesterday. Skip if nothing meaningful.
